en: Black‑and‑white view of an old stone ruin in a forest. Only sections of the outer walls remain, with large arched and rectangular window openings. Several children and a man stand in the openings and at the base of the wall, dressed in early‑20th‑century clothing. The building appears roofless and overgrown, surrounded by tall, leafless or sparsely leafed trees. No caption or printed text is visible on the image side.
